# Lovable

> > Lovable is an AI-powered development platform that transforms ideas into production-ready web applications through natural language prompts, with integrations for Supabase, GitHub, Stripe, and major AI services.

Founded by Anton Osika, Lovable enables rapid prototyping and full-stack development with visual editing, two-way GitHub sync, and pre-built connectors for ElevenLabs, Twilio, Perplexity, and more. The platform supports both no-code builders and developers using Cursor AI workflows.

## Key Topics

- Lovable AI development platform
- Supabase integration and authentication
- GitHub two-way sync
- Cursor AI workflow
- AI app builder and rapid prototyping
- No-code development
- ElevenLabs voice integration
- Twilio API integration
- Stripe payment integration
- Tailwind CSS styling
- SaaS startup development
- AI-powered website building
- Webflow alternatives
- Perplexity and Firecrawl connectors
- Production app deployment
